transitions.boundary: Blink-derived production ownership and the vector-only DPR 1/2 gate are exact on the verified macOS run. Computed perspective/origin, the non-box inline stacking/fixed-owner split, and perspective/preserve-3d fixed-containing-block ownership are source-audited and gated. DM-2469 captures transformed text as ordered all-transform-neutral physical fragments plus complete signed live-paint matrices, with zoom retained locally, exact restoration/correlation checks, same-origin frames, and explicit outer Chromium ownership for unavailable or projective facts. DM-2470 consumes that neutral bundle through one signed residual matrix across every text paint branch and removes transform-derived font magnitudes, unsigned ancestor products and anisotropic correction. DM-2471 independently gates direct live/neutral/restored quads and final Chromium-versus-SVG device-space ink/content over 25 cases at DPR 1/2 on macOS/Linux/Windows with eight mutations and no platform envelope. DM-2359 pauses every participating document timeline before any prepass, exposes the exact sampled CDP quad/computed composition/residual/outer raster owner, and gates rotate3d, translate3d, matrix3d, perspective/origin, preserve-3d, grouping flattening, and additive composition at four frames and DPR 1/2 on all three platforms. Refused, drifting, changing-enumeration, or non-document timelines fail explicitly rather than being approximated in 2D. The affine plane and UTF-16 shaped origins/advances are browser/protocol owned; baseline still inherits the normal segment metric seam (explicit segment baseline, else captured ascent plus physical origin), behaviorally checked by final ink rather than a separately decoded Blink fragment-baseline protocol row. The animated viewBox path has source-derived function-first composed sweeps and explicit unknown retention, validated by doc 166's all-platform gate.
